name: boundscript
description: Human-defined architectural boundaries for agent-driven development.

scripts.test:unit: npm run build:native && npm run build:welcome && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/internal -v && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s experiments/minimal-box -v && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s experiments/native-typescript-contracts -v && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s experiments/render-welcome-native -v
scripts.check: npm run test:unit && npm run test:native:tooling && npm run test:welcome:tooling && npm run test:contact:contracts && npm test
scripts.test:native: npm run build:native && python3 -B experiments/native_cli.py verify normalize-contact
scripts.test:native:baseline: npm run build:native && python3 -B experiments/native_cli.py verify normalize-contact --baseline
scripts.generate:native: npm run build:native && python3 -B experiments/native_cli.py generate normalize-contact
scripts.test:welcome: npm run build:welcome && python3 -B experiments/native_cli.py verify render-welcome
scripts.generate:welcome: npm run build:welcome && python3 -B experiments/native_cli.py generate render-welcome
scripts.generate:orders: npm run build:orders && python3 -B experiments/native_cli.py generate process-orders --agent-owned --retain-candidate
